messages:
maria: quick sync — I'm trying to repro the intermittent regression from last week's roll using a new synthetic harness. current thought: the failure only shows up under -> steep long-tail traffic + KV cold prefixes. thinking of a small RFC for a generator we can iterate on.

ash: sounds good. can you outline the shapes you want? ramp + bursts? what about QPS floor/ceiling?

maria: yes. plan: 3 phases — 1) steady baseline (10–20 qps) for 5m, 2) log-linear ramp to target over 60s (20 -> 800 qps), 3) burst storms (3x spikes of 2s, 10s, 30s) interleaved with long-tail noise. key knobs: kernel-selection toggles, batch-size cap, kv-warm-prefix-ratio.

simon: fwiw, kernel selection interacts weirdly with very short bursts because the runtime flips to small-seq kernels and then back; that flip path had the regression. we should include forced-kernel flags in the harness so we can run apples-to-apples.

maria: exactly. harness will support: forced_kernel: [auto, small_seq, large_seq], batching_mode: [dynamic, fixed(N)], kv_prefix_hit_rate: float, prefix_lengths: distribution.

ash: also add a cold-start subroutine: pick N unique prefixes and replay them with no cache population to measure cold-kv penalty. label traces with prefix id.

maria: good call. will add a coldwave block. initial config snippet: 

```json
{
  "seed": 42,
  "phases": [
    {"type":"steady","qps":15,"duration_s":300},
    {"type":"ramp","from_qps":20,"to_qps":800,"duration_s":60,"shape":"log-linear"},
    {"type":"burst_series","pattern":[{"dur":2,"mult":3},{"dur":10,"mult":5},{"dur":30,"mult":4}],"gap_s":20},
    {"type":"tail_noise","dist":"pareto","alpha":1.7,"rate_scale":0.1,"duration_s":600}
  ],
  "kernel_flags": {"forced_kernel":"auto","per_request_override":true},
  "batching": {"mode":"dynamic","max_tokens":1024,"max_batch_size":64},
  "kv": {"prefix_pool_size":2000,"kv_prefix_hit_rate":0.25,"cold_wave_pct":0.2}
}
```

eva: nice. when you run this make sure to capture: per-kernel latency histogram, GPU kernel names, nvprof-like timeline (or CUPTI traces), and per-request batch_size. small suggestion: include a metric for kernel-switch-frequency (how often we change kernel per model instance).

maria: adding. also thinking about warmup semantics — we should support a "kv_warmup_sequence" where 30% of requests in steady phase are synthetic prefetches that populate the KV with typical prefix lengths to emulate real reuse.

simon: for apples-to-apples comparisons between builds: pin model sha, quant config, and disable model-fallback routing and admission control. otherwise the runtime hides the pathological path.

ryan: telemetry question — can we tag traces with harness-phase and prefix-id so the console dashboards can correlate spikes with the config block? need that for regression alerts.

maria: yes—harness will push tags: harness.phase, harness.run_id, kernel_forced, prefix_id. also will emit a short summary JSON per run with aggregated histograms so we can store in S3 for apples-to-apples diffs.

ash: thinking about long-tail shaping: pareto alpha tuning + injecting jitter into inter-arrival times reduces synchronization artifacts. include both deterministic seeds and randomized runs so we can reproduce and also stress.

eva: small perf-profiling tip: run a short golden baseline (fixed seed) after each build and compute KS distance on the latency quantiles vs the golden. if KS > threshold flag as potential regression.

simon: when you enable forced_kernel=auto, add a counter for "auto_decision_path" and record the heuristic inputs (seq_len, qps_window, batch_fill). hard to debug otherwise.

maria: good. one more: for KV behavior test we should vary "prefix_reuse_window" and emit warm/cold ratio over time. baseline idea: 5s reuse window for short reuse, 60s for long reuse.

ryan: question re batching heuristics — can the harness simulate multi-tenant mixing? a small background low-qps stream can drastically change batching headroom.

maria: yes. we'll support overlay streams with configurable weight: overlay_streams: [{qps: 2, templates: [..]}, ...]. that'll help simulate multi-tenant pressure on batch formation.

ash: run plan? propose: 3 builds x 5 runs each x 2 seeds x 2 kernel-forced modes = 60 runs. collect per-run artifacts + one aggregated apples-to-apples diff.

maria: sounds fine. I'll schedule runs on the staging pool tonight. leaving a short checklist: 1) harness config schema, 2) tags and trace keys, 3) forced-kernel and batching overrides, 4) kv warmup/coldwave, 5) profiling hooks, 6) golden baseline/KS check.

eva: :thumbsup: can you post the first run link here when done? I want to compare GPU timelines.

deploy-bot: deployment started for branch synth/harness/loom at staging (build 2026-03-18T02:11Z) — job 87921 kicked off.

maria: thanks — will post run artifacts and TL;DR in ~2h. if anyone wants to add experiment cases add comments to the config PR.

ryan: quick add — include a "latency_inflight_cap" parameter so we can test behavior when the dispatcher rejects requests to keep tail bounded. that was part of the regression window.

maria: added to checklist. final note: aim is deterministic repro of the regression so we can root-cause the kernel flip + kv cold interaction. want the harness to be usable both for perf teams and for CI smoke runs.

ash: great. thanks for pulling this together.

maria: thanks. uploading config PR now: https://git.internal/redwood/synth-harness/pulls/42
